cells.gaps: FinScope's 82% is adults with access to formal financial services, not account holding alone. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: The FinScope Consumer Survey 2025 finds 82% of adults formally served, four in five or more, read as account holding as Nigeria's formal inclusion is. No survey gives the share paying digitally.
